notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
We've fixed a few minor bugs:

[list]
[*] Air speed indicator should now be working
[*] Kills were not properly counted towards your score
[*] Range distance callouts have also been fixed
[/list]
We're actively monitoring your feedback and working on new fixes in the upcoming weeks. We also hope you're enjoying the game!
